The file birds.R contains the code for performing all tha analysis is the First real data example of the paper.

- data.csv contains count data of bird species observed in 200 locations over time
- Ctree.tre contains the phylogenetic tree of the species observed
- traits.csv contain sinformation on the species observed (mass, habitat)
- grid1000.csv and grid10000.csv contain information about the locations (habitat, temperature...)
